rows.contract: Default Vulkan on outside NetBSD, with explicit Vulkan disable supported.
rows.native_mapping: Keep existing choices when Metal is off. Make Vulkan unavailable in a Metal configuration, even if it was requested.
rows.expected_result: CMake option fixture preserves the previous Vulkan cache preference and reports effective OFF only where required.
rows.actual_result: Passed. See command output in evidence path.

rows.contract: Cocoa, AVFoundation and IOSurface remain shared; MoltenVK is selected from system or bundled conditionally and differs between iOS and macOS.
rows.native_mapping: Leave all existing Apple branches intact. Use the effective Vulkan option to bypass MoltenVK in the Metal build and separately publish native framework paths.
rows.expected_result: Metal configure has no MoltenVK discovery, link dependency or download. Shared Cocoa and AVFoundation remain available.
rows.actual_result: Passed. See command output in evidence path.

rows.contract: The Vulkan build owns SPIR-V and Vulkan dependencies, with system and bundled alternatives.
rows.native_mapping: Exclude the entire branch in a native configuration.
rows.expected_result: Ninja graph has no Vulkan renderer, MoltenVK, Vulkan include directories, sirit, VMA, SPIR-V or glslang target edges.
rows.actual_result: Passed. See command output in evidence path.

rows.contract: The renderer sources and private Vulkan target dependencies are conditionally added to video_core.

rows.expected_result: No renderer_vulkan translation units or execution dependencies appear in the native compiler or linker graph.
rows.actual_result: Passed. See command output in evidence path.

rows.contract: Qt adds Vulkan headers only when Vulkan is enabled.
rows.native_mapping: Frontend build sees Vulkan disabled when Metal is enabled and retains its own shared dependencies.
rows.expected_result: Real Qt CMake configure succeeds and has native-only backend dependency closure.
rows.actual_result: Passed. See command output in evidence path.

rows.contract: Per-draw behavior is outside the top-level build file contract.
rows.native_mapping: No Vulkan API or runtime mapping is imported in Phase 001. Existing Vulkan source is read-only.
rows.expected_result: Source and generated compiler dependency inspection excludes Vulkan execution sources and private headers.
rows.actual_result: Passed. See command output in evidence path.

rows.contract: CMake enables native sources and SDK checks but actual settings.cpp and Qt frontend compile commands omit ENABLE_METAL; native settings selectors and conditional bridge would be inactive.
rows.native_mapping: Publish ENABLE_METAL to actual targets only after successful native mode and Apple SDK checks.
rows.expected_result: Native settings and Qt compile actual conditional code; off mode lacks modifier, native dependency graph has no Vulkan unit. PICA 48/801 and 64 CTest.
rows.command: cmake configure, SDK probe, build native tests and native Qt consumers
rows.actual_result: SDK arm64 ARC check and full native target rebuild; actual -DENABLE_METAL in settings and Qt compile commands; native GetWorkingGraphicsAPI/default Spatial and Software verified by linked fixture; off graph unchanged; no Vulkan compilation; PICA 48/801 and CTest 64 passes plus 5 existing skips.

rows.contract: The same native Qt Apple bridge is compiled by both citra_qt and citra_meta without ARC, which is incompatible with the retained Metal device handles returned by the ARC native platform interface.
rows.native_mapping: Enable ARC only on the existing Metal Qt bridge in its two source-owning target directories when ENABLE_METAL is selected.
rows.expected_result: Both native actual compile entries use ARC, opt-out remains independent, native SDK and regression continue to pass.
rows.command: cmake configure Qt and native tests; compile exact source entry
rows.actual_result: Native SDK configure succeeded and both actual Qt/Meta compile entries include ARC exactly once and ENABLE_METAL. Native-only per-source flag, no Vulkan units; real Qt bridge compile and link evidence follows in 079.

rows.contract: Native MetalARC bridge belongs to the Qt target alone.
rows.native_mapping: Remove the broad inherited root ARC property after ownership moves to citra_qt private build registration. Preserve native backend option and platform framework checks.
rows.expected_result: Compiler graph contains one Qt Objective-C++ ARC bridge, legacy feature-off Apple source registrations are unchanged, build and regression evidence passes.
rows.actual_result: Verified native/off Qt graph, role-local ARC and complete native target link.
